beats.beat_title: Scene 1 — The Matching Green Crop (Target Word: crop)
beats.google_flow_scene_asset: Theme A Beginning Blend.pdf Page 38 (page-038.png) & act1_scene1_crop_flow_bw.png
beats.verbatim_storyline_script: Plum fluttered down onto the garden fence. "Follow me!" she chirped. Clem grinned and hopped over the gate. "I'm right behind you!" Together they walked past rows of green plants, ready to see what the crop had grown this season. Plum catches the question in Clem's mind and says: "See all these matching spinach plants? When we grow a whole field of the exact same plant, that big group of plants is called a crop! Clem, you know we owe a big thanks to our farmers. They grow large batches of plants on purpose to be harvested for food or clothing. I like to eat sunflower seeds from the bird feeder. What is your favorite food? Strawberries? Carrots?"

beats.beat_title: Scene 2 — Digging Up Delicious Spuds (Target Word: spud)
beats.google_flow_scene_asset: Theme A Beginning Blend.pdf Page 43 (page-043.png) & act1_scene2_spud_flow_bw.png
beats.verbatim_storyline_script: Clem and Plum walk by the potato patch. Lovely green lush grown potato plants were swaying. Plum said, "A long time ago, gardeners used a little shovel called a 'spud' to dig up treats from the ground. Because they used that shovel to find potatoes, people just started calling the potatoes 'spuds' too!" "Look! You know what a potato is, right? Well, 'spud' is just a secret, silly nickname for a potato! It's like how a dog is sometimes called a pup," said Clem, digging his hands into the soft dirt. Clem pulled out a round, dusty spud. "Found one!" Plum said, "Whenever you eat French fries or mashed potatoes, you are actually eating delicious spuds!"
